requirements: Projects have members (project_members). Members see the tasks of their projects and may add tasks to them. A task may be assigned to a user, who must be a member of the task's project; only the assignee may update a task (including handing it to another member or unassigning it), and it stays in a project the updating assignee belongs to. Nobody deletes tasks. Additionally a project owner (owners are recorded in task_owners and must be members of the project) may delete tasks of their project.
expected_properties: Tasks are only seen, added and changed by members of their project.
Only the assignee updates a task.
Leaving a project never grants access.
An assignee is always a member of the task's project.
Whatever is written can be read back.
The application role may only select/insert/update/delete tasks and select project_members and projects.
A member can read the tasks of their projects.
A member can add an unassigned task to their project.
An assignee can mark their task done.
A project owner can delete any task of their project.
